bars.note: pyROAR was minted 1:1 for every ROAR burned in the Burning Lion Festival (Sept 2023 → Sept 2024). Two ways to receive it: a PyROARmaniac who sent their own ROAR to the burn got the same amount back in pyROAR, and every time Lion DAO burned from its treasury (10x the community's burn, up to 8B a month — 4B to open the festival, prop #95) that pyROAR was shared out to ROAR stakers. So a balance is a wallet's own burn PLUS its staker share — not its burn alone. The token is frozen, so the ledger no longer moves; every account is walked and summed against total_supply daily (burn/holders).
bars.lead: {pyroar.holder_count|int} holders of the festival's pyROAR — the largest wallet holds {pyroar.top1_pct|pctPlain}.
